notes: Modified cash basis, treated as cash. Governmental from Total Governmental Funds column (p5); beginning/ending are fund balances 318,566/290,165 (ending includes due from other funds 39,052). Other general receipts 61,046 split using statement of activities (charges 48,362 p2, licenses 5,785, misc 6,899 p3); business Other 2,605 split (investment income 771, misc 1,834, p3). Business-type from proprietary statement total column (p7); disbursements total 634,022 = operating 599,481 + non-operating 34,541 (printed on p2). Proprietary detail totals exclude bond principal/interest printed below Total operating expenditures. Only supplementary schedule is the all-funds budget schedule (pp8-9), so detail is per fund column of p5 and p7 (user 2026-10-27). Balance sheet from government-wide statement (p1). Read pages 1-9 of 9
